description: Données Temps-réel de circulation des bus de Monaco via le réseau CAM is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Data GOUV. Le standard GTFS-Realtime (GTFS-RT) constitue l'extension dynamique du modèle GTFS statique. Il permet d'enrichir l'information voyageur avec des données en temps réel, offrant une visibilité immédiate sur l'état opérationnel du réseau de transport. Ce flux est essentiel pour les applications mobiles, les systèmes d'aide à l'exploitation et les outils d'analyse de mobilité urbaine. Coverage: Data GOUV. The publisher named on the listing is Data GOUV. Its keywords include cam, perturbations-transport, monaco, geolocalisation-temps-reel, transport-en-commun, retards-bus. The listing shows 6 download or service links in OTHER. The listing shows 2026-06-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-fr.
